title: Holding Several Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes at Once
content:
**Clause.** A customer may hold several Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes products at the same time, including several of the same product, subject to the per-product limit of the holding-limits rule.

There is no overall maximum on the number of companion certificates and passes one customer may hold across all products; the only ceiling is the per-product limit on certificates or passes of one product held in issued or active status.

| Question | Answer under this clause |
|---|---|
| May a customer hold a Crestline Companion Certificate Main Cabin and a Crestline Companion Pass Annual at the same time? | Yes. |
| May a customer hold two certificates of the same product at the same time? | Yes, within that product's per-product limit. |
| Is there a cap on the total number of companion products across all products? | No such cap exists. |
